remotely-kpler:lever:60231a55-25f6-41c7-.descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Kpler’s Agriculture & Dry Bulk business unit is rapidly expanding its Metals & Minerals coverage and is looking for an analytical, data-literate Metals Insight Analyst to join its growing team.

In this role, you will use Kpler’s industry-leading, real-time trade flow data to produce original, market-shaping research across exchange-traded metals (copper, aluminium, nickel, zinc, lead) and energy-transition materials (lithium, manganese, chrome). You will translate raw data into sharp short, medium, and long-term views on supply, demand, and price direction.

Because you are joining a high-growth business unit, you will play a foundational role in the evolution of our product. This is a truly hybrid-minded position where you will serve as the subject matter expert bridging the gap between market reality and technical architecture-partnering closely with our dedicated data operations team to build, refine, and validate fundamental datasets.

Your mission is to:

  • Market analysis and publications: Produce timely research on metals markets-covering trade flows, supply/demand dynamics, price drivers, and macro themes-drawing on Kpler's proprietary data alongside external sources.
  • Price outlook: Form and maintain a view on the price outlook for metals within your coverage; defend this view through publications, client interactions, and public commentary.
  • Fundamental S/D research and data development: Build and maintain supply and demand balance frameworks for commodities within your remit, and work closely with the data operations team to develop and validate the underlying datasets that support them.
  • Webinars and events: Represent Kpler at industry events, webinars, and conferences; contribute to media outreach and build Kpler's profile within the metals community.
  • Client and commercial support: Contribute to client engagement alongside Sales and Customer Success, translating complex data and analysis into clear commercial narratives.
  • Product input: Identify gaps in Kpler's metals coverage and contribute to the product roadmap by surfacing analytical needs and proposing data enhancements; collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership content and event programming.

Essential

  • 3–6 years of experience as a Commodity Analyst or Researcher with a focus on metals or closely related markets
  • Advanced Excel and data modelling; ability to build and manage large datasets
  • Demonstrable experience producing published market research, reports, or commentary
  • Hands-on experience working with trade data, pricing series, inventory data, and/or positioning data
  • Experience building or contributing to supply/demand balance models or quantitative market frameworks
  • Comfortable forming and communicating a price view to external audiences

    •  

    Desirable

  • A foundational understanding of SQL or Python is highly valued. We are looking for an analyst with a strong appetite and capability to develop and deploy these programming skills alongside our data teams to automate workflows and enhance our proprietary databases.
  • Experience working with proprietary or real-time trade flow data
  • Prior involvement in data or product development alongside a research role
  • Established industry network and/or media profile within metals

    •  

    Behavioural Competencies

  • Intellectually curious: proactively interrogates data, questions assumptions, and pursues deeper understanding
  • Collaborative and hybrid-minded: comfortable bridging analytical and technical workstreams
  • Self-directed: drives projects to completion independently, managing competing priorities across research and data work
  • Commercially aware: understands what clients and markets care about and frames analysis accordingly

    •  

    Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Economics, Statistics, Business, Data Science, Earth Sciences, Engineering, or equivalent).

    •  

    We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

     

    We make things happen

    We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

     

    We build together

    We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

     

    We are here to help

    We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.


    Our People Pledge

     

    Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

     

    Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.

serena-electra:teamtailor:f3aa7152-c89c-.title: Strategic Funding Analyst
serena-electra:teamtailor:f3aa7152-c89c-.descriptionHtml:
🏠 What We Do

Born in 2021 from the desire to make cities less polluted and quieter, Electra is helping to shift usage towards electric mobility by tackling the main barrier: charging.

Electra is constantly innovating to make electric vehicle charging easier, with a network of fast charging stations (20 minutes on average) and a maximally simplified user experience.

Based in Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes, Brussels, Madrid, Zurich, Vienna, Munich, Milan and Amsterdam, Electra's teams aim to deploy a network of 15,000 fast charging points by 2030, proud to contribute to the energy transition in Europe.

In 5 years, we have:

  • Deployed +700 stations and over 4,000 fast-charging points

  • Secured thousands of stations to establish Electra as a leader in the European market

  • Opened several offices in France and Europe

  • Raised over €1 billion in equity and debt financing from renowned investors and institutions

  • Joined the French Tech Next 40 and won the European Scale-up of the Year 2024 award

  • Assembled a team of over +250 talents… and this is just the beginning!

💼 Your Mission

We are looking for a Strategic Funding Analyst to strengthen Electra's Strategic Funding team.

Reporting to Cyril Douady, Electra’s Strategic Funding Manager, you will play a key role in both the ongoing management of Electra's asset portfolio and the structuring of new financing transactions. You will sit at the intersection of financial analysis, investor relations, and deal execution, with high visibility across the business.

🎯 Your Responsibilities

1. Financing

  • Financial analysis & deal support: run financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic funding decisions, including debt structuring, equity sizing, and returns assessment for new projects

  • Investment committee & board materials: prepare high-quality presentation materials for investment committees and board meetings in the context of new financing transactions, ensuring clarity, sharpness, and appropriate level of detail for senior stakeholders

2. Asset Management

  • Strategic committee materials: build and present clear, structured presentations for strategic reviews with existing co-investors, covering portfolio performance, key developments, and forward-looking priorities

  • Investor & lender reporting: prepare regular financial and operational reports for existing debt and equity partners, tracking performance against agreed KPIs and covenants

  • Contract management: manage the monthly billing cycle across the portfolio, from data consolidation to invoice issuance, ensuring full alignment with contractual terms and internal financial reporting

😎 Your Profile

Technical skills

  • Financial modelling: excellent Excel skills, with proven ability to build, audit, and stress-test financial models ; project finance or LBO modelling experience is strongly valued

  • Financial & contractual analysis: able to independently review and analyse financial statements, Facilities Agreements, Shareholders' Agreements, and investment documentation, with a basic grasp of legal mechanics and an eye for compliance requirements

  • Presentation skills: ability to structure and communicate complex financial information clearly and concisely for senior audiences

Behavioural skills

  • Rigorous and analytical: you approach every problem with a structured and analytical mindset, always taking pride in the quality and consistency of your outputs

  • Autonomous and hands-on: you are comfortable taking ownership of your tasks and working independently, while knowing when to ask the right questions and seek guidance

  • Well-organised and multi-tasking: you can manage several topics simultaneously, switching context quickly without losing focus

  • Collaborative: you work well with cross-functional teams (M&A, Legal, FP&A) and are comfortable interfacing with external partners (banks, investors, advisors)

  • Critical thinking : you proactively look for ways to streamline processes and leverage AI to improve efficiency and quality

Experience & background

  • Master’s degree graduate in Business, Engineering, Economics or equivalent

  • Up to 2 years of relevant professional experience ideally in investment banking, consulting, private equity, or project finance / M&A

  • Fluent in both French and English (written and spoken) is required

  • Knowledge of the EV or energy infrastructure sector is a plus, but genuine interest in the energy transition is a must

⚡️ What Electra Offers You

  • An immersive role at the core of Electra's finance activity, with immediate exposure to live deals, lender relationships, and strategic financial decisions

  • A stimulating environment to grow: as part of a fast-scaling team, you will be encouraged to develop your skills and broaden your scope over time, both in depth and in the range of topics you cover

  • A collaborative and mission-driven environment where finance is a core driver of strategy

  • Real impact on the energy transition and the future of mobility

  • An attractive compensation package with fixed and variable components

  • Brand-new offices in the 2nd arrondissement of Paris

  • 2 days of remote work per week

  • Alan health insurance (50% covered by Electra)

  • Meal vouchers via Swile card (€10/day, 50% covered by Electra)

  • 25 paid vacation days + 12 RTT days

  • SYNTEC collective agreement (including vacation bonus and additional leave for special occasions)

  • A quarterly company-wide event with the entire Electra team

  • Sustainable Mobility Package

  • Access to the company benefits platform (CSE) with numerous perks (culture, sports, etc.)

  • Access to a platform dedicated to mental health, including up to 4 sessions per year with certified practitioners, covered by Electra

Even if your profile doesn't match 100% of every criterion, we encourage you to apply. At Electra, we strive to create an environment where everyone feels comfortable, safe, and free to be themselves.

We are committed to equal opportunities and do not tolerate any discrimination based on religion, cultural background, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability. 💚 We value potential, motivation, and a learning mindset just as much as experience. 🚀

🗓️ Recruitment Process

  1. Talent Acquisition Interview - Raphaël (Senior Talent Acquisition)

  2. Hiring Manager interview - Cyril (Strategic Funding Manager)

  3. Case study

  4. Final fit interview - Clément (CFO)

somacap-cognition-2-35df6b59-5a1c-4a14-b.title: Applied AI Transformation Manager
somacap-cognition-2-35df6b59-5a1c-4a14-b.descriptionHtml:
We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer, and Windsurf, the AI-native IDE. Together, they represent our vision for collaborative AI teammates that enable engineers to focus on more interesting problems and empower teams to strive for more ambitious goals.

Our team is small and talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin and Windsurf is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

About the Role

Applied AI Transformation Managers are technically oriented strategic advisors and operators who ensure value alignment to our customer's most strategic projects and drive program delivery across several strategic accounts. You’ll be responsible for identifying strategic opportunities for our customers to realize value from Cognition’s platform and ensuring strong value capture and reporting. You will support delivery of enterprise wide programs to implement agentic AI, specifically by designing and building the operating model and delivery model for agentic AI.

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to senior and functional leaders, designing value realization targets and delivering transformation programs. This role embeds with a select set of Cognition’s strategic accounts for upfront strategy work through in-depth program management and delivery. You will be on the frontlines of supporting customers turning productivity gains and quantifiable financial impact. You will pioneer the playbook for how the world’s largest enterprises get value from AI Agents.

In this role, you will:

  • Work with customer leadership to identify, quantify and report value targets for productivity gains and financial impact

  • Ensure seamless operations and delivery for the overall customer program, in close partnership with the Cognition account team

  • Ensure everyone at customer and Cog has visibility on playbook implementation, consumption metrics and value metrics

  • Maintain great relationships and customer trust via delivery

  • Oversee onboarding and rollout to thousands of engineers, ensuring successful deployment

  • Apply world class analytical and technical program management skills to support customer executives and teams, particularly with value realization and tracking

  • Build centers of excellence within accounts and empower them through tailored enablement programs

Requirements for the role:

  • Computer science or EE undergrad

  • SWE intern or full time work experience

  • 3-5 years at a big 3 strategy consulting firm with a strong background in value targeting and realization and technology strategy as well as a proven track record building and expanding client relationships

  • Ideally 2+ years experience at a startup in a customer facing role preferred

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments—you move quickly and grow quickly

  • Demonstrated ability to learn exceptionally fast

You might excel if you…

  • have successfully been a part of complex enterprise teams, especially sourcing and managing account growth

  • have worked as a software engineer, SE, technical account manager or other technical role

  • previously founded a startup or were early stage at a high growth startup

  • are a competitive, highly ambitious person who loves working in high-intensity environments

Equal Opportunity

Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any.

somacap-tractian:lever:63931888-0418-483.descriptionHtml:
Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.


What You’ll Do

As a Technical Support Automation Specialist at TRACTIAN, you will serve as the bridge between technical support and automation engineering, providing high-level technical assistance to our clients and ensuring robust integration of our monitoring solutions in industrial environments. You will be responsible for validating, implementing, and maintaining industrial communication systems, integrating PLCs and sensors, interpreting electrical diagrams, and ensuring system performance. You will also act as a technical reference during the implementation and post-implementation phases, supporting both on-site and remote operations.

  • Provide technical support for automation-related issues, ensuring the correct operation and integration of sensors, PLCs, and monitoring platforms.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems involving industrial communication protocols, electrical diagrams, and control systems.
  • Interpret and adjust electrical diagrams and PLC logic during installations or support requests.
  • Collaborate with Hardware, Data Science, and Product teams to improve hardware-software integration in industrial environments.
  • Knowledge of electrical equipment and networks, as well as terminology related to this field and their applications: power factor, phase diagram, consumption, reactive power, phases, etc
  • Provide both remote and on-site support to ensure customer satisfaction and reduce downtime.
  • Document technical cases, customer interactions, and solutions through our Helpdesk and CRM (HubSpot).
  • Assist in identifying technical opportunities for upsell, expansion, or system optimization.
  • Share knowledge internally and contribute to the creation of technical documentation related to automation and industrial integration.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Previous experience in B2B technical support roles or industrial automation projects.
  • Experience with sensor installation and sizing (vibration, temperature, pressure, flow, etc.).
  • Knowledge of SCADA/DCS systems and industrial instrumentation.

sorensoncap-bureau:ashbyhq:a221c313-e748.title: Product Designer
sorensoncap-bureau:ashbyhq:a221c313-e748.descriptionHtml:
About Bureau

Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.

Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.

Why Bureau?

Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.

As a Product Designer at Bureau, you will shape how users visualize, manage, and optimize risk decisions. You’ll be responsible for the end-to-end UX/UI for sophisticated capabilities, including workflow builder, orchestration, behavioural biometrics UI, rule configuration, and Device ID reporting. Your designs will bring clarity, trust, and precision to decision-making in high-stakes environments.

What you’ll be doing

  • Translate complex orchestration flows, rule engines, and case management dashboards into intuitive, user-friendly designs that empower risk, product, and engineering teams

  • Create end user experience to build advanced, super clean and intuitive onboarding and verification journey for large enterprises

  • Create seamless experiences for fraud, risk, and security management platforms.

  • Build and maintain design systems, components, and style guidelines to ensure consistency across Bureau’s multi-signal platform.

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate AI-powered workflows into cohesive visual experiences; ensure feasibility and fidelity throughout the design journey.

  • Conduct research and usability studies with real users in risk, product, and compliance functions to iterate interfaces that deliver clarity, speed, and trust.

  • Provide pixel-perfect assets and design specs that accelerate development and elevate execution quality.

What You’ll bring

  • 2-3 years of hands-on experience as a Product Designer in enterprise SaaS, ecommerce, or FinTech.

  • Experience in building customer facing user journeys for B2C brands.

  • Expertise in crafting visually compelling, UI-rich mockups with a strong sense of design taste.

  • Ability to translate Bureau’s brand values in all the clear design solutions.

  • Demonstrated ability to design complex data-rich interfaces, such as dashboards, workflow builders, or admin tooling.

  • Mastery of Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD, prototyping tools (like Framer, rive and/or lottie), and collaborative design systems.

  • Strong UI/UX sense with emphasis on information architecture, interaction design, data visualization, and accessibility.

  • Resolute attention to detail, advocacy for usability and accessibility, and passion for turning complex problems into elegant solutions.

Bonus Points

  • AI Efficiency: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, or Figma AI plugins) to accelerate research, UX writing, or workflow automation.

  • Motion Design: Experience creating micro-interactions to enhance the user experience.

  • Technical Foundation: Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS or how front-end frameworks operate.

Our Culture

  • We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way

  • We value performance, not hours worked

  • Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

Compensation

  • Competitive salary + potential equity

  • Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

uppartners-unitx-labs:ashbyhq:07b68d8a-4.descriptionHtml:
Job Title:

Account Executive

About Us:
UnitX builds the world's leading physical AI systems to automate repetitive visual tasks in factories. UnitX is a fast-moving startup with a team from Stanford, MIT, Google, and beyond. Since inception, UnitX has deployed 1,000+ mission-critical systems across 190+ of the world's leading manufacturers' production lines. Every year, $15B worth of products go through UnitX's AI inspection system to ensure quality.

We are looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our team supporting us in the next phase following our Series B. AI is completely changing the manufacturing industry and we are at the forefront of this change. This is a huge opportunity for personal growth and growth within UnitX as we continue to make an impact on this industry. You will report directly to the Director of North American Sales in continuing our sales efforts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the full sales cycle from outreach to close, selling UnitX’s industrial AI solutions to factories and manufacturing teams

  • Learn customer pain points and use a consultative approach to position UnitX as a high-impact solution

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through outbound prospecting, follow-ups, and qualifying inbound interest

  • Partner with the technical team to tailor demos and proposals based on each prospect’s needs

  • Track all sales activity and pipeline data in HubSpot to stay organized and improve forecasting

  • Collaborate closely with leadership, product, and marketing to share feedback and improve the go-to-market motion

  • Help improve and document sales playbooks, outreach strategies, and deal processes as we grow the sales team

Who You Are:

  • 3 or more years of full-cycle B2B sales experience, ideally in industrial or technical solution selling

  • Confident communicator who can build credibility with both technical stakeholders and business leaders

  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting and finding creative ways to connect with new accounts

  • Organized and driven, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

  • Experienced in using HubSpot (or a similar CRM) to manage pipeline and track deal progress

  • Bonus if you’ve sold into industrial, manufacturing, or AI/automation markets

Our Perks:

  • Competitive salary, uncapped commission, equity, and 401k

  • Full Medical, Dental, Vision

  • Unlimited PTO

verdane-caia-cosmetics:teamtailor:c42b25.title: Beauty Consultant, Berlin
verdane-caia-cosmetics:teamtailor:c42b25.descriptionHtml:
CAIA Cosmetics wurde 2018 in Stockholm gegründet – mit der klaren Vision, kompromisslos hochwertige Beauty-Produkte zu erschwinglichen Preisen zu entwickeln.

Seitdem steht CAIA für leistungsstarke, sorgfältig entwickelte Produkte, die Qualität, Funktionalität und Ästhetik vereinen. Inspiriert von unserer skandinavischen Herkunft verbinden wir Leichtigkeit, Wärme und klares Design mit durchdachter Produktentwicklung.

Wir glauben, dass Schönheit ein Gefühl ist – strahlend, mühelos und ganz individuell. Qualität, Zugänglichkeit und eine starke Community bilden das Fundament unserer Marke und prägen alles, was wir tun.


DEINE ROLLE

Für unseren Counter in Berlin suchen wir dich als Beauty Consultant (m/w/d) in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit.
Du bist unser CAIA Brand Ambassador auf der Fläche und begeisterst unsere Kund:innen mit authentischer Beratung und deiner Leidenschaft für Beauty. Mit deinem Gespür für Trends, Produkte und individuelle Bedürfnisse schaffst du ein besonderes Einkaufserlebnis und baust persönliche Kundenbeziehungen auf.



DEINE AUFGABEN

Verkauf & Kundenberatung

  • Du berätst unsere Kund:innen individuell, typgerecht und bedürfnisorientiert

  • Du inspirierst mit deinem Produktwissen und schaffst ein positives, einladendes Einkaufserlebnis

  • Du unterstützt aktiv dabei Umsatzziele zu erreichen

Produktexpertise & Beratung

  • Du bist Expert:in für unsere Produkte – von Inhaltsstoffen über Texturen bis hin zu Shades und Anwendungstechniken

  • Du demonstrierst unsere Produkte professionell und bietest Make-up Touch-ups direkt am Counter an

  • Du berätst individuell, typgerecht und trendbewusst

  • Du stellst höchste Hygiene- und Servicestandards sicher

Community & Markenpräsenz

  • Du repräsentierst CAIA authentisch und überzeugend auf der Fläche

  • Du baust aktiv langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst einen festen Kundenstamm

  • Du setzt POS-Aktivierungen, Events und Promotion-Aktionen professionell und wirkungsvoll am Counter um

Counter Support & Warenpräsentation

  • Du sorgst für eine ansprechende Präsentation unserer Produkte gemäß Visual-Merchandising-Vorgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei der Pflege des Counters und achtest auf Ordnung und Sauberkeit

  • Du hilfst dabei, die Warenverfügbarkeit am Counter sicherzustellen

DEIN PROFIL

  • Erste Erfahrung im stationären Einzelhandel, idealerweise im Beauty- oder Premiumsegment

  • Leidenschaft für Make-up, Beauty und aktuelle Trends

  • Gute Produkt- und Anwendungskenntnisse im Bereich Make-up

  • Eine Ausbildung als Make-up Artist oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil

  • Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind zwingend erforderlich, Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

VERGÜTUNG

Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt – abhängig von Deiner Qualifikation, Berufserfahrung und Deinen individuellen Kompetenzen – in Vollzeit zwischen 28.000 € und 38.000 € brutto jährlich. Zusätzlich erhältst Du einen attraktiven jährlichen Bonus, der an die Erreichung vereinbarter Ziele geknüpft ist. Dich erwartet außerdem ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit einem starken Teamzusammenhalt sowie regelmäßigen Teamevents und gemeinsamen Aktivitäten, die den Austausch fördern und den Teamspirit nachhaltig stärken.

Bei CAIA wirst du Teil einer der spannendsten und am schnellsten wachsenden Beauty-Brands Skandinaviens. Dich erwartet ein kreatives, dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Teamgeist, Community und Expertise eng miteinander verbunden sind. Als Beauty Consultant treibst du nicht nur den Verkauf voran — du baust Beziehungen auf, teilst dein Wissen und schaffst inspirierende Beauty-Momente, die Kund:innen zu echten CAIA Fans machen.

Wenn du Retail und Beauty liebst, Freude am Aufbau einer Community hast und mit fachlicher Expertise überzeugen möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Lass uns gemeinsam die Erfolgsgeschichte von CAIA weiterschreiben.
